raw:
Agent Name: FileSurfer  
Step Number: 4  
Reason for Mistake: FileSurfer encountered repeated "404 File Not Found" errors when attempting to access the relevant PDFs for both the March 2021 and July 2020 papers. Instead of escalating appropriately or resolving the path issue, the agent repeatedly attempted to open the same incorrect file path, leading to no progress in retrieving the X-ray time spans for comparison. The core issue appears to be a failure to properly access and extract the required content, which caused the overall process to stall and ultimately led to an incomplete and incorrect conclusion (31 seconds).
